release_notes.en:
### What's New in ArgonMusic v3.2.3

• **Minimalist Mode Audio-First + Complete 3-Dot Menu**: Minimalist Focus mode stays primarily on audio/artwork, adds a Watch Official Music Video toggle inside the 3-dot menu, and exposes all hidden features (Lyrics, Visualizer, Musical Universe 3D, Equalizer, Signal Path, Queue, Add to Playlist, Offline Download, Share, Sonic Match) in the 3-dot menu.
• **Fixed Android Discord Rich Presence**: Gateway RPC now waits for READY, cleans Gateway OP 3 activity/image payloads, reliably extracts WebView login tokens, and auto-connects on Android startup.
• **Includes v3.2.2 Windows 1080p/720p Music Video & Android 8–16 Downloads Fixes**.
